entries.903dcbaa20d5d7a2: An electronic components manufacturer headquartered in Tottori City, Tottori Prefecture. Together with its subsidiaries, it conducts research and development, manufacturing and sales of electronic components such as various sensor products and module products, and related products. As it operates a single business, revenue is not disclosed by product category; consolidated net sales in the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥27,325 million. Employees as of December 31, 2025 numbered 1,377.
